# Subscription billing revamp

*Client industry: fitness | Completed: 2025-03-28 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p01*

## The problem
The client was a fitness app with failing recurring payments.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using server-rendered React pages, TypeScript, Stripe, a relational database with proper migrations. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project recovered 12% of failed renewals with retries and dunning emails.
